weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the novelty of the proposed extensions over existing conformal prediction methods.
The paper lacks a comprehensive comparison with existing methods, which would strengthen the claims of improved performance.
Some theoretical results are presented without sufficient context or motivation, making them harder to appreciate.
The examples provided are limited in diversity and do not cover a wide range of applications, which could limit the generalizability of the findings.
strengths: The proposed conformal risk control method extends the applicability of conformal prediction to a broader class of loss functions.
The theoretical guarantees provided are rigorous and contribute to the understanding of risk control in machine learning.
Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method in practical applications, showcasing its potential impact.
